name: Select Enhancer for Elementor Forms with Select2
author: Kamrul Islam

sections.description:
Select Enhancer for Elementor Forms with Select2 upgrades default Elementor Pro form select fields into powerful, user-friendly dropdowns using Select2.

It automatically converts standard <select> fields into advanced dropdowns with search, multi-select, and tagging support — improving usability and form experience instantly.

No configuration required. Just install and activate.

🎥 Demo Video

Watch how it works:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AVqAaBG4tD4

✨ Key Features

  • 🔍 Searchable dropdowns for better UX
  • ✅ Multi-select support
  • 🏷️ Optional tagging support
  • 🎨 Clean, modern Select2 UI
  • ⌨️ Keyboard-friendly navigation
  • ⚡ Lightweight and optimized loading
  • 🔌 Works automatically after activation
  • 🎯 Fully compatible with Elementor Pro Form widget

🚀 Why Use This Plugin?

Elementor’s default select fields are limited and lack search functionality.

This plugin enhances them with:

  • Faster selection for large datasets
  • Better usability for users
  • Modern UI without custom coding
  • Improved form conversion experience

Perfect for:

  • Country or city dropdowns
  • Product attribute selection
  • Dynamic data lists
  • Category or taxonomy selection
  • Large multi-select fields

🔧 How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Open any Elementor Pro form
  3. Add a select or multi-select field
  4. Select2 will automatically be applied

No shortcode. No settings. No extra steps.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin via WordPress dashboard
  3. Open Elementor Pro Form widget
  4. Your select fields are now enhanced with Select2
sections.faq:
Does it require Elementor Pro?

Yes. This plugin works with the Elementor Pro Form widget.

Do I need to configure anything?

No. It works automatically after activation.

Does it support multi-select fields?

Yes. Multi-select fields are fully supported.

Will it slow down my site?

No. Assets load only when Elementor forms are detected.

Does it affect other select fields?

No. It only targets Elementor Pro form select fields.
